data.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-ticket-update-rav.sh before the read-after-write wrapper exists (RED). Tests cover all mutation operations and the mismatch detection path.

## Test Cases
1. ticket create → re-read → written fields match → exits 0
2. ticket edit title → re-read → title matches → exits 0
3. ticket tag → re-read → tag present → exits 0
4. ticket transition → re-read → status matches → exits 0
5. Simulated write failure (mock): re-read returns mismatched value → exits 1 with JSON error {operation, intended_value, actual_value}
6. ticket link → re-read → link present in deps → exits 0

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-ticket-update-rav.sh exits non-zero (RED — wrapper not yet created)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-ticket-update-rav.sh

## Testing Mode
RED
data.title: T1: RED — Write test suite for ticket-update-rav.sh (read-after-write)
